Title: The Wisdom of Gildor
Text: I've met an elf named Gildor Inglorion, who asked me to search the next Silmaril stone. He thinks a dwarf named Barin in West-Peak has found it. The dwarves of the Iron Hills are stubborn but also friendly. If they have found the Silmaril, I need to get it before it corrupts the mind of the dwarves.
CompleteText: I've found West-Peak in the Iron Hills. Now I need to find a dwarf named Barin. He should be inside the main hall. If Gildor was right, Barin has found one of the Silmaril stones.
